summary: This bill amends the Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act of 2006 to require federal award information to be posted online within 3 days after the award instead of within 30 days.

scores.thoughts: The bill amends the timing requirement for public posting of federal award data from 30 days to 3 days. This affects only the speed of disclosure and does not alter appropriation levels, authorize new spending, or mandate cuts. Therefore it has no bearing on whether government spending expands or contracts.
The legislation addresses only the public reporting schedule for federal awards and contains no provisions related to tax rates, credits, deductions, or revenue collection.
No provisions in the bill address healthcare delivery, insurance markets, public coverage, or regulatory structures for medical services.
